prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Trait & Appearance Studio Layout: Redesign the pet companion selection screen into a split interactive studio layout with live preview styling and companion audio feedback. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (68.9%) and long completion times; a dedicated interactive studio redesign makes custom pet setup engage users faster.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Preview & Pet Compatibility Screen: Add a new screen before path choice that shows interactive companion previews and feature differences between pre-made and custom AI pets. (why: Choose path drop-off is 20.1% with huge mean time variation (514s), indicating users hesitate because they do not understand path differences.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Pet Command Sandbox Flow: Add a interactive command sandbox flow at onboarding finish where users test desk pet gestures, summoning, and hiding commands directly. (why: Support mail highlights queries from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding, contributing to finish step drop-off (71.7%).)
3: [sign_in, reorder] Sign In Post-Waiting Desktop Ready Stage: Move sign_in to occur after the pet rendering waiting screen right when the desktop pet is ready for launch. (why: Leverages the completion momentum of a fully rendered pet to incentivize sign in while clarifying cloud save necessity.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Safety & Anti-Stall Guarantee Notice: Enable desktop notification toggle on the waiting screen with safety and background rendering progress reassurance copy. (why: Support received reports of app stalling before launch, while long mean wait times (2336s) leave users unsure if rendering is progressing.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Shortcut & Visibility Callout: Update home_intro text to prominently explain keyboard shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P) for hiding, showing, and interacting with the desktop pet. (why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on the desktop, contributing to 71.7% finish conversion.)

Adding a new screen clarifies path choices but introduces additional onboarding friction.
Backed by funnel data and support queries, though interactive flow built from scratch is costly.
Reordering sign-in builds on value delivery, but target step has relatively low drop-off (15.2%).
Addresses high mean wait time and support stall reports with clear progress feedback.
Config/copy-only change resolving explicit user confusion at a high drop-off step (28.3%).
